notes.title: Mycosis v1.08: New Music Tracks, Improved Animations, and Enhanced Performance!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

[h3]Mycosis is celebrating its first anniversary on Steam! Join the celebration with a new update featuring new music tracks, improved performance, and refined animations![/h3]

[h3]What's New in Version 1.08?[/h3]

[list]
[b][*]New Music Tracks[/b] - By chance, I stumbled upon three more awesome tracks from the band Fertilizer that I thought were lost on an old HDD! 😄 More about the band here: https://bandzone.cz/fertilizer

[b][*]Polished Animations[/b] - Fixed texture synchronization for bleeding and infection effects with character movement. New animations for some creatures. Improved synchronization of object movement carried on characters' backs 🎞️

[b][*]Optimized Performance[/b] - I’ve tweaked the algorithms for collision detection and texture rendering a bit – this should ease the load on weaker computers! 🤓

[b][*]Some Small Bug Fixes[/b] - A bunch of small bugs squashed, mostly incorrect texture flipping and death-related issues! 🤪

[/list]

[h3]I hope you enjoy the anniversary celebration as well![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41847384/8940d0a43756a18e88a42e7c50b09f3db991d355.png[/img]

notes.title: Mycosis v1.07: Controller Ready, Visually Revamped, and Much More!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

[h3]I'm excited to announce a major update for the Mycosis! This update focuses on a new UI design and full gaming controller support.[/h3]

[h3]What's New in Version 1.07?[/h3]

[list]
[b][*]Full Controller Support[/b] - Now compatible with Xbox and Steam Deck controllers!

[b][*]Revamped User Interface[/b] - Monochromatic retro design optimized for easy navigation with gaming controllers.

[b][*]New Achievements[/b] - New achievements and hidden rooms added for players to discover.

[b][*]Bug Fixes[/b] - Numerous bugs fixed, including improvements to autosave functionality.

[b][*]Enhanced Maps[/b] - Expanded with new quests and dialogues, plus improved game tutorials.
[/list]

[h3]I hope you enjoy this update![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41847384/dda7f73f19efc694cbb485ba050057401ce301e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41847384/e7f0c943d4eba859793449911c58fe0e52561688.png[/img]

notes.title: Mycosis v1.06a
notes.content: Fixed a critical bug in the drone map! An explosive barrel blocking the door could explode upon entering the map, and if the player uses the drone, it is not possible to switch back from drone control to the player. If you have encountered a similar issue, please use a save from before the drone room.

notes.title: Mycosis v1.05f
notes.content:
